config.language.description: Language of the extension: both the interface (notifications, hovers, help panels, diagnostics, run output) and the command documentation database. Defaults to English. Command palette titles follow the VS Code display language instead.
config.language.enum0: English interface and English command documentation
config.language.enum1: Chinese interface and Chinese command documentation
config.language.enum2: Follow the VS Code display language
config.version.description: Tool/version identifier. Built in: 25.1 (Innovus) and test (empty data). Custom tool directories (e.g. dc) can be added under data/innovus/.
config.versions.description: [Deprecated] The version list is scanned automatically from the data/innovus/ directory.
config.enableAITools.description: Enable Copilot AI tool integration (lets Copilot query the Innovus command database and parse TCL scripts)
config.enableDiagnostics.description: Enable TCL static checking (bracket/quote matching, command argument validation, similar command suggestions)
config.enableCompilation.description: Enable cross-file TCL compilation analysis (reads all scripts through the .f file and tracks variable definitions and references)
config.fFile.description: Path to the .f file (relative to the workspace root) that lists the TCL scripts to compile and their order. One .tcl file path per line, compiled top to bottom.
config.helpStyle.description: Display style for F12/Ctrl+Click help documentation
config.helpStyle.enum0: Webview rich panel (tutorial-style layout, option analysis, example hints)
config.helpStyle.enum1: Plain text editor tab (man page style)
config.diagnosticLevel.description: Strictness level of the static checker
config.diagnosticLevel.enum2: All checks + type validation + similar command suggestions
config.aiPrompt.description: Custom AI analysis prompt. Leave empty to use the built-in default prompt.
config.tclshPath.description: Custom tclsh interpreter path (absolute). Leave empty to search automatically: bundled (macOS arm64) > system PATH. Linux/Windows users need a system tclsh installed or must set this path manually.
config.runSaveOutput.description: Save the output to a file after running a TCL script.
config.runOutputDir.description: Directory where run output files are saved. Leave empty to use the workspace .innovus-run/ directory.
config.simOutputMode.description: How simulated output files are handled: dry-run only simulates, mkdir creates directories and empty files automatically.
config.simOutputMode.enum0: Simulate only, do not create any files or directories
config.simOutputMode.enum1: Create output directories automatically (mkdir -p) and generate empty output files
